# The words

The probe answers *what is in here*. This part is the other half: taking what
you want out.

Four words so far — `rows`, `first_present`, `take` and `where` — and each one
had to earn its place against a rule that is deliberately hard to satisfy:

> **A word belongs in fathom only if removing it makes one of the fixed
> questions unanswerable on at least one corpus file. No word is added without
> naming the question it answers and the file that proves it.**

Every word in this part is shown in both languages, because **the premise of the
project is that they read the same**. That is a claim, not a courtesy, and it is
checked rather than asserted: the two spellings come from two independent
implementations and a harness diffs what they return on real documents.
